name: io.github.sergii-ziborov/weavatrix-refactor
description: Transactional refactoring MCP with 11 evidence-backed tools, hash-bound previews, and rollback.

packageArguments.description: Absolute path to the initial local repository; defaults to the current directory

environmentVariables.name: WEAVATRIX_ALLOW_SOURCE_EDITS
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to authorize confirmed apply operations and rollback to write source files; unset, the refactor tools stay preview-only
